report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'; the dialog changed to 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and the speed of Bahn 1 in the Control Panel went to 60. After the 25-second wait the new snapshot still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' with the disabled button; the dialog never asked to place Bahn 2. The Betriebsprotokoll still showed 'Noch keine Ereignisse.'
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'. After waiting 25 seconds the new snapshot showed the dialog still reading 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' with a disabled button; Bahn 1's speed in the Control Panel had changed from 0 to 60. The dialog never asked to place Bahn 2; the Betriebsprotokoll still said 'Noch keine Ereignisse.' (click, wait and snapshot were sent together in one message)
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: First setup asks for the first train and shows the switch hint
Expected: A dialog asks the user to place the first train ('Bahn 1') on the calibration point and offers a button to confirm this, and the page shows a hint that the user should check whether the switches are set correctly
Observed failure: The 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog appears with the hint 'Bitte prüfen, ob die Weichen richtig gestellt sind.', but it asks for the wrong train: 'Bitte Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.' with button 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'; the track plan already shows 'Bahn 1 auf front-left'. Same result in a fresh browser context, so the state comes from the server (probably left over from an earlier test).
Steps completed before failure: 2

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'; Bahn 1's speed went from 0 to 60. After the 25-second wait the dialog still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' with only a disabled button; Bahn 2 appeared only as a preview 'Danach: Bitte Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.' without a confirm button. The log still said 'Noch keine Ereignisse.' (click, wait and snapshot sent in one message)
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' (toast 'Alle Strecken zurückgesetzt' appeared) Start was clicked and the page read immediately: badge stayed 'Gestoppt', Start still shown, but no message appeared; the status area was empty. A second click and a 3-second wait for the text 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle' showed nothing either.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and Start, the badge still showed 'Status: Gestoppt' and the Start button was still there, but the message never appeared; a second click and a 3-second wait for 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle' timed out; no toast or banner in the screenshot.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled, and the track graphic shows markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' in the second tab and the 25-second wait, the second tab still showed the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert …', Start disabled and only a Bahn 1 marker. The first tab (not reloaded) showed no dialog, Start enabled and both markers; re-checking the second tab later it matched. (click, wait and snapshot were sent in one message)
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' calibration started (Bahn 1 shown on the track, speed 0 -> 60). 25 seconds later the dialog still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and only mentioned Bahn 2 as a later request ('Bitte Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen, sobald Bahn 1 die Wartestelle erreicht hat.'); the 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' button was still disabled, so Bahn 2 could not yet be confirmed.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2': the trains passed each other and both keep reaching their stops
Observed failure: Since Start (22:25:29): Bahn 1 weicht aus, wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis (22:25:34), fährt weiter (22:25:48), then reaches H2/H4/H2/H4. Bahn 2 has no '… erreicht …' after 22:25:48: weicht aus 22:25:55, wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis 22:26:34, kalibriert 22:26:39–42, weicht aus 22:27:26, wartet/fährt weiter 22:27:37; from 22:27:08 Bahn 1 was also waiting on the siding with no 'fährt weiter' by the final snapshot.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further '… erreicht …' entries for both trains
Observed failure: After Start, waits on the siding were followed by calibration ('wird kalibriert'/'ist kalibriert') instead of 'fährt weiter'; Bahn 2 reached a stop only once in 2 minutes
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Bahn 1 moves clockwise and Bahn 2 counter-clockwise on the main loop in at least one pair of consecutive screenshots; the trains do not circle in the same sense
Observed failure: Bahn 1 moved clockwise in every pair; Bahn 2 went from the siding near Weiche 1 up the left curve and along the top straight to the right, i.e. clockwise, then to the siding/calibration point; Bahn 2 was never seen moving counter-clockwise
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further '… erreicht …' entries for both trains
Observed failure: Bahn 2 waited and continued ('fährt weiter') and Bahn 1 kept reaching stops, but in over 2 minutes after Start there was no 'Bahn 2 erreicht …' entry; Bahn 2 only evaded, waited and was calibrated
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled, and the track graphic shows markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: 25 s after confirming Bahn 2 in the second tab, its snapshot still showed the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog with 'Bahn 2 wird kalibriert …', Start disabled and only the Bahn 1 marker; a few seconds later both tabs showed the completed state
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further '… erreicht …' entries for both trains
Observed failure: Bahn 1 waited, continued and kept reaching stops; Bahn 2 had no 'erreicht' entry after either of its 'fährt weiter' entries
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history shows a new calibration-speed entry after normal-speed entries, followed by normal speed again
Observed failure: In about 2 minutes after Start the log only showed Bahn 1 alternating between Haltestelle 2 and 4; no calibration entries and no Bahn 2 entries at all; Bahn 2 speed stayed 0 (history ends '60 forward → 0 → 110 backward → 0'), Bahn 1 history shows no new 60 entry
Steps completed before failure: 13

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain normal-speed forward entries; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from calibration each train uses only one non-zero speed
Observed failure: Histories and single speed value were fine, but when the console was read both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 showed speed 0 (Bahn 2 waiting on the siding, Bahn 1 had stopped 0.4 s earlier)
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: wartet / fährt weiter for the same train and afterwards '… erreicht …' entries for both trains
Observed failure: wait/continue pairs present and Bahn 1 kept reaching stops, but Bahn 2 reached no stop after any 'fährt weiter'
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Bahn 1 moves clockwise and Bahn 2 counter-clockwise in at least one pair of consecutive screenshots; the trains do not circle in the same sense
Observed failure: Bahn 1 moved clockwise; Bahn 2 also moved clockwise on the main loop (from Weiche 1 up the left curve, along the top straight, down the right curve) and then towards the calibration point; Bahn 2 was never seen moving counter-clockwise
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: wartet / fährt weiter for the same train and afterwards '… erreicht …' entries for both trains
Observed failure: wait/continue pairs present and Bahn 1 kept reaching stops, but Bahn 2 reached no stop after any 'fährt weiter' within about 2 minutes
Steps completed before failure: 11
